node.statement: PART II — THE PURIFICATION CHANNEL (ACORN TRICK). Theorem 1.1: There exists a quantum channel Phi^{d,r} such that Phi^{d,r}(rho^{tensor n}) = E_{|rho_bar>}[|rho_bar><rho_bar|^{tensor n}], implementable to delta error in diamond distance in time poly(n, log d, log 1/delta). Proof via Schur basis decomposition (Lemma 3.1), pure state Schur formula (Lemma 3.2), random purification formula (Lemma 3.3), and efficient Schur transform implementation.
